modinfo.title: CD Hard Enemies, Normal Bosses
modinfo.author: Tommy
modinfo.description: On Normal difficulty, characters on the regular difficulty buff (BuffLevel_Difficulty) use the Hard level instead: more HP, knockdown resistance, faster attacks and movement. Bosses and mini-bosses (the boss difficulty buff, plus boss-named characters on the regular buff) and the player are unchanged. Built for Crimson Desert 2.03.02. Each change also carries entry + rel_offset so DMM can re-anchor it by record if a future patch moves things.
